description.narrative: Kosovo Compact: the MCC-Kosovo Compact will help modernize the country's energy sector and create a business-enabling landscape. The details of the program are still being developed.

condition.narrative: Appointment of an entity or individual to provide fiscal agent services, as approved by MCC, until such time as the Government provides to MCC a true and complete copy of a Fiscal Agent Agreement, duly executed and in full force and effect, and the fiscal agent engaged thereby is mobilized.

Appointment of an entity or individual to provide procurement agent services, as approved by MCC, until such time as the Government provides to MCC a true and complete copy of the Procurement Agent Agreement, duly executed and in full force and effect, and the procurement agent engaged thereby is mobilized

Before each Disbursement of Program Funding for payment under a particular works or construction contract for a given Project or Activity, MCA-Kosovo must submit evidence, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, that MCA-Kosovo or the appropriate Government entity is implementing the requirements of each ESIA, ESMP, HSMP, RAP or LRP as appropriate, for such Project or Activity in all material respects and consistent with the Environmental Guidelines (including the IFC Performance Standards that are incorporated by reference therein)

Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding for any activity to be carried out under an implementing entity arrangement, MCA-Kosovo must deliver to MCC a copy of a signed agreement between MCA-Kosovo and the relevant Implementing Entity that sets forth the roles and responsibilities of each party with respect to the Project or Activity, which agreement must be in form and substance satisfactory to MCC

Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding for payment under a particular works or construction contract for a given Project or Activity, MCA-Kosovo must submit evidence, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, that MCA-Kosovo or the appropriate Government entity has developed, as appropriate, an environemntal and social impact assessment (ESIA), environemntal and social management plan (ESMP), a Health and Safety Management Plan (�HSMP�), a resettlement action plan (RAP), and/or livelihood restoration plan (LRP) with respect to such Project or Activity, each of which must be in form and substance satisfactory to MCC
Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding, MCA-Kosovo must develop and adopt a Fiscal Accountability Plan, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC
Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding, MCA-Kosovo must develop and adopt a comprehensive M&E Plan, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC.
Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding, MCA-Kosovo must develop and adopt a comprehensive Social and Gender Integration Plan, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC

Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding, MCA-Kosovo must develop and adopt an ESMS, including a stakeholder engagement plan (SEP), each in accordance with the Environmental Guidelines, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC
Each of the Key Staff has been selected and engaged by MCA-Kosovo and approved by MCC.

For any CFF Disbursement occurring after this Compact has entered into force in accordance with Article 7: MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (i) MCC has received copies of any reports due from any technical consultants (including environmental auditors engaged by MCA-Kosovo) for any Activity since the previous Disbursement Request, and all such reports are in form and substance satisfactory to MCC

For any CFF Disbursement occurring after this Compact has entered into force in accordance with Article 7: MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (ii) the Implementation Plan Documents and Fiscal Accountability Plan are current and updated and are in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, and there has been progress satisfactory to MCC on the components of the Implementation Plan for any relevant Projects or Activities related to such CFF Disbursement

For any CFF Disbursement occurring after this Compact has entered into force in accordance with Article 7: MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (iii) there has been progress satisfactory to MCC on the M&E Plan and Social and Gender Integration Plan as defined in the PIA for the Program or relevant Project or Activity and substantial compliance with the requirements of the M&E Plan and Social and Gender Integration Plan (including the targets set forth therein and any applicable reporting requirements set forth therein for the relevant Disbursement Period)

For any CFF Disbursement occurring after this Compact has entered into force in accordance with Article 7: MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (iv) there has been no material negative finding in any financial audit report delivered in accordance with this Compact and the Audit Plan for the prior two quarters (or such other period as the Audit Plan may require)

For any CFF Disbursement occurring after this Compact has entered into force in accordance with Article 7: MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (v) MCC does not have grounds for concluding that any matter certified to it in the related MCA Disbursement Certificate, the Fiscal Agent Disbursement Certificate, or the Procurement Agent Disbursement Certificate is not as certified

For any CFF Disbursement occurring after this Compact has entered into force in accordance with Article 7: MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (vi) if any of the officers or key staff of MCA-Kosovo have been removed or resigned and the position remains vacant, MCA-Kosovo is actively engaged in recruiting a replacement
If a Fiscal Agent has been engaged, the Government (or MCA-Kosovo) has delivered to MCC, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, a Fiscal Agent Disbursement Certificate
If a Procurement Agent has been engaged, the Government (or MCA-Kosovo) has delivered to MCC, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, a Procurement Agent Disbursement Certificate
If any proceeds of the CFF Disbursement are to be deposited in a bank account, MCC has received satisfactory evidence that the Bank Agreement has been executed
If any proceeds of the CFF Disbursement are to be deposited in a bank account, MCC has received satisfactory evidence that the Permitted Accounts have been established.

MCA-Kosovo has been legally established and the Government has provided MCC with copies of all decrees, legislations, or other documents relating to the establishment of MCA-Kosovo and its operations (including the Internal Regulations and HR Manual). MCA-Kosovo has developed and adopted the HR Manual, and the manual has been approved by MCC.
MCA-Kosovo has delivered to MCC a certificate of MCA-Kosovo, dated as of the date of such Disbursement Request, substantially in the form provided by MCC (the �MCA Disbursement Certificate�)
MCA-Kosovo has delivered to MCC a certificate of the Fiscal Agent, substantially in the form provided by MCC (the �Fiscal Agent Disbursement Certificate�)
MCA-Kosovo has delivered to MCC a certificate of the Procurement Agent, substantially in the form provided by MCC (the �Procurement Agent Disbursement Certificate�)
MCA-Kosovo has delivered to MCC a completed Disbursement Request, together with the Periodic Reports covering the related Disbursement Period.
MCA-Kosovo has delivered to MCC copies of any reports from any technical (including environmental) auditors engaged by MCA-Kosovo for any Activity delivered since the previous Disbursement Request
MCA-Kosovo has developed a complete Implementation Plan.
MCA-Kosovo has developed the Fiscal Accountability Plan (or an interim version), and the plan has been approved by MCC.

MCA-Kosovo must establish for the JETA Project (i) an indicator to measure the Project Objective, including a definition, Baseline, and Target and (ii) a beneficiary analysis, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC
MCC determines that, after signature of this Compact, the Government has not engaged in a pattern of actions inconsistent with the eligibility criteria for MCC Funding

MCC has determined in its discretion that MCA-Kosovo has complied in all material respects with its obligations set forth in Section 2.1(d) with respect to the establishment of a bid challenge system (BCS)
MCC has determined in its discretion that MCA-Kosovo has complied in all material respects with its obligations set forth in Section 2.1(f) with respect to the establishment of an M&E Plan

MCC has determined in its discretion that MCC does not have grounds for concluding that any matter certified to it in the related MCA Disbursement Certificate, Procurement Agent Disbursement Certificate or Fiscal Agent Disbursement Certificate is not as certified

MCC has determined in its discretion that The Government has complied in all material respects with its obligations set forth in Section 2.9 with respect to the making of its contributions in accordance with the projected timeline set forth in Annex III

MCC has determined in its discretion that all Government entities involved in the implementation of the Program, including the Implementing Entities, are coordinating successfully with MCA-Kosovo and dedicating the necessary staff and other resources to ensure successful implementation of the Program
MCC has determined in its discretion that all applicable conditions precedent in Annex II have been duly satisfied, deferred or waived as provided in this Agreement

MCC has determined in its discretion that any Taxes paid with MCC Funding through the date ninety (90) days prior to the start of the applicable Disbursement Period have been reimbursed by the Government in full in accordance with Section 2.8(c) of the Compact
MCC has determined in its discretion that each of the Key Staff remains engaged, or if a position is vacant, MCA-Kosovo is actively engaged, to MCC�s satisfaction, in recruiting a replacement

MCC has determined in its discretion that no act, omission, condition, or event has occurred that would be the basis for MCC to suspend or terminate, in whole or in part, the Compact or MCC Funding in accordance with Section 5.1 of the Compact

MCC has determined in its discretion that no material default or breach of any covenant, obligation or responsibility by the Government, MCA-Kosovo or any Government entity has occurred and is continuing under the Compact, this Agreement or any other Supplemental Agreement

MCC has determined in its discretion that the Government has satisfied all of its payment obligations, including any insurance, indemnification, tax payments or other obligations, and contributed all resources required from it, under the Compact, this Agreement and any other Supplemental Agreement

MCC has determined in its discretion that the Implementation Plan Documents are current and updated and are in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, and there has been both progress on, and compliance with, the components of the Implementation Plan for any relevant Projects or Activities related to such Disbursement (including the targets set forth therein and any applicable reporting requirements set forth therein for the relevant Disbursement Period), in each case, satisfactory to MCC
MCC has determined in its discretion that the activities to be funded with such Disbursement shall not violate any applicable law or regulation

MCC has determined in its discretion that there has been no material negative finding in any financial audit report delivered in accordance with the Compact and Audit Plan, for the prior two quarters (or such other period as the Audit Plan may require)

MCC has not determined, in its sole discretion, that an act, omission, condition, or event has occurred that would be the basis for MCC to suspend or terminate, in whole or in part, this Compact or MCC Funding in accordance with Section 5.1 of this Compact

MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (i) the activities being funded with such CFF Disbursement are necessary, advisable or otherwise consistent with the goal of facilitating the implementation of this Compact and are not expected to violate any applicable law or regulation

MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (ii) no material default or breach of any covenant, obligation, or responsibility by the Government, MCA-Kosovo, or any Government entity has occurred and is continuing under this Compact or any Supplemental Agreement

MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (iii) there has been no violation of, and the use of requested funds for the purposes requested are not expected to violate, the limitations on use or treatment of MCC Funding set forth in Section 2.7 of the Compact or in any applicable law or regulation

MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (iv) any Taxes paid with MCC Funding through the date 30 days prior to the start of the applicable Disbursement Period have been reimbursed by the Government in full in accordance with Section 2.8(c) of the Compact

MCC is satisfied, in its sole discretion, that (v) the Government has satisfied all of its payment obligations, including any insurance, indemnification, tax payments, or other obligations, and contributed all resources required from it, under this Compact and any Supplemental Agreement
The Compact has entered into force as provided in Article 7 of the Compact.

The Government (or MCA-Kosovo) has delivered to MCC, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC a completed Disbursement Request, together with the applicable Periodic Reports, for the applicable Disbursement Period, all in accordance with the Reporting Guidelines;

The Government (or MCA-Kosovo) has delivered to MCC, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, a certificate of the Government (or MCA-Kosovo), dated as of the date of the CFF Disbursement Request, in such form as provided by MCC;
The Government (or MCA-Kosovo) will have delivered a CFF Procurement Plan acceptable to MCC.
The Government (or MCA-Kosovo) will have delivered an interim fiscal accountability plan acceptable to MCC.

The Government delivers to MCC a letter signed and dated by the Principal Representative of the Government, or such other duly authorized representative of the Government acceptable to MCC, confirming that the Government has completed its domestic requirements necessary for this Compact to enter into force and that the other conditions precedent to entry into force in Section 7.2 of the Compact have been met

The Government delivers to MCC a signed legal opinion from the Head of the Legal Department for the Ministry of Finance, Labour and Transfers of Kosovo (or such other legal representative of the Government acceptable to MCC), in form and substance satisfactory to MCC

The Government delivers to MCC complete, certified copies of all decrees, legislation, regulations or other governmental documents relating to the Government�s domestic requirements necessary for this Compact and the PIA to enter into force, which MCC may post on its website or otherwise make publicly available
The Government shall determine the ownership structure for the MFES Entity
The Program Implementation Agreement is signed by the parties thereto;
The conditions set forth in Annex V have been satisfied
